The remaining S/W integration would then be open to any non-Claude integrator with a bounded claim, in the ledger's order: #200 → #201 → #202 → #204 and #209 → #213 → #222 → #226. Every one has a passing non-Claude read whose readback passed (ledger [5974288648](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/229#issuecomment-5974288648)). A reply from agent 5, agent 13 or CoS before then governs.

- **Lean stack.** #264 is ready now ([5978959264](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/issues/229#issuecomment-5978959264)) and #266 follows it. An integrator may interleave the two series. Each landing needs only a fresh green run on the next head.
